A BETTER FIRST REPAIR

A few simple steps.

Get the most out of your cleanup workspace.

01

Choose your clip

Upload a browser-playable video up to 500 MB. Your video is processed on your computer in the local studio.

02

Mark the watermark

Pause at a clear frame and drag a box around the logo or text. For moving or animated marks, choose mask keyframes, scrub to new times, and redraw the box. Add positions at turns and size changes. The mask interpolates between positions; this is manual guidance, not automatic object tracking.

03

Review the result

Use Preview to test three seconds around the playhead before a full export. Detail mode compares local and scene motion, refines residual movement, and synthesizes missing texture. Synthesized areas are estimates. Coverage shows source use, not a guarantee of accurate reconstruction.
